title: Display a list of links to admin functions
description: On the admin pages, there should be links to all the functions listed in the UIS that a user can perform.

title: Display descriptions of admin functions
description: There should be a short description under each link that describes each function a user can perform, as listed in the UIS.

title: Make admin function links lead to operation pages
description: Each of the links on the admin pages for user functions should direct the user to the operation page for that function.

title: Enable admin to Add/Create a new user
description: There should be a page where an admin user can add a new user. This should only be available to users who are signed into an account with admin privileges. Otherwise, the page should display an error message blocking the user from accessing it.

title: Create a manual Add/Create new user form
description: In the new user page, there should be a link to a form to create a new user. It should have fields like user name, display name, division, designator code, and lab location.

title: Add a user role field to the new user form
description: There should be a field in the new user form for the user role. This should be a multi-select that allows the user to select from the list of possible roles in the company or division.

title: Create new user templates for the Add/Create new user form
description: On the new user form page, there should be an option to create a new user based on a template. This should prompt the user to select from a number of possible templates that describe certain types of users. When they choose one, this should automatically fill out the form with the information from that template, which the user can then submit.

title: Make templated new users inherit roles from template
description: When a new user is created using a template, the user should automatically inherit all of the user roles from the template.

title: Create button to add additional roles to template
description: When a new user is being created based on a user template, there should be a button next to the roles field that allows the admin to manually add additional roles. These should then appear alongside the inherited roles from the template.

title: Check if new user already exists
description: When a new user is being created, search through the system database, using the display name and user name columns, to check if that user is already present.

title: Display error if new user already exists
description: If, after a check of the database, the new username already exists in the database, display and error and do not add the duplicate to the database.

title: Make Add User the default tab
description: When an admin user opens the program, the Add User tab should open automatically and should appear as open in the tab list.

title: Check if new user is active in the Active Directory
description: When a new user is being created, search through the Active Directory to check if that user is active.

title: Display error if new user not active in Active Directory
description: If a search finds that the new user being created is not active in the Active Directory, an error should be shown to the user.

title: Save new users to database
description: When the save data button is clicked on the form, the new user should be added and saved into the users database.

title: Add confirmation message to form
description: After the data in the new user form is saved, display a confirmation message.

title: Add warning message to form
description: If the cancel button is clicked on the new user form, the system should display a warning message saying that the data input will be deleted.

title: Put Add User form on every tab
description: A link to the Add User form should be displayed on all of the tabs so that admin users can start the process from any tab.

title: Mark required fields with asterisk
description: All required fields in the Add/Create User form should have a red asterisk next to them.

title: Create save data button on new user form
description: At the bottom of the new user form, there should be a save data button which will save the information the user entered and create the new user in the database.

title: Create cancel button on new user form
description: At the bottom of the new user form, there should be a cancel button, which cancels the process of creating a new user.

title: Delete data after cancel button clicked
description: When the cancel button is clicked, all the data inputted in the new user form should be cleared.

title: Redirect to Add User page after cancel button clicked
description: When the cancel button is clicked, the user should be redirected out of the form and to the original add user page.

title: Enforce required fields
description: The fields role, division, designator code, and lab location should be required in the Add/Create User form. One or more answers can be give for each of these fields.

title: Create required fields error message
description: If the fields role, division, designator code, or lab location are not filled in, show an error message.

title: New users don't save to database
description: Fill out a form to create a new user, then press save and check in the database. That new user should appear, but they do not.

title: Record notification emails about errors
description: When a user is redirected to the error page, this should trigger the system sending an email to the Client Services email distribution list. The email should include the title of the error in the subject and more details in the body of the message.

title: Log errors to external data file
description: Any time a user recieves an error, warning, or information notice, the message should be logged onto a log file stored on the application server.

title: Open help overview page on opening popup
description: When the help pop-up is opened, the "Overview" page should appear by default.

title: Create linked list of help topics on popup
description: On each help page in the popup, there should be a list of links that provide help on related topics.

title: Put help links on every page
description: Every page should have a link called "Help" in the top right corner of the screen.

title: Create link to open help pop-up
description: The "Help" links should open the help pop-up to the page that corresponds with the page they were opened from. These pages should contain information from the user manuals about this topic.

title: Make design of help pages consistent
description: All of the help page should have the same CSS styling, including the consistent color scheme and background that the company has requested.

title: Include company logo on help pages
description: In the top right corner of all of the help pages, display a small image of the company logo.

title: Show index on help popup
description: At the bottom of the help popup, there should be a link to an index page. This page should show a list of important terms and topics that appear in the help manual, with links to relevant help pages.

title: Show glossary on help popup
description: At the bottom of the help popup, there should be a link to a glossary page. This should show a list of terms that appear across the system and their definitions.

title: New users saving without required fields
description: Fill out a new Add User form and leave the required fields blank, then press the submit button. The form allows the new user to be saved rather than displaying an error and rejecting the submission.

title: Error when redirecting from canceled form
description: Start filling out a new Add User form, then hit the cancel button. The form should redirect to the Add User page, but instead an error appears saying that page does not exist.

title: Adding additional roles to new user deletes inherited ones
description: Fill out a new Add User/Create form based on a template. On the user role field, click the button to add an additional role, then hit submit. Then look at the database for the new user that was just created. It will only show the additional role you added, rather than showing that role as well as the roles it should inherit from the template.

title: Company logo displaying incorrectly
description: Open one of the help pages and look at the top right corner of the screen. The company logo should be there, but instead there is a placeholder/error image which is too big and covering some of the text on the page.

title: Active Directory error not logged to file
description: Create a new user on the Add User form who is not active in the Active Directory, then hit submit. An error will appear on the screen, but if you check the error log file, that error will not appear there, even though it should.

title: Existing display names of users not found in search
description: Create a new user with the same display name but a different user name than an existing user. The database search will find that that user does not already exist and will allow a duplicate user to be created.

title: Add User page available to users without admin access
description: Sign in on a test regular user account and open the url for the Add User page. Even though you are signed in as a regular user, you will be able to view the page and the Add/Create new user form, whereas it should kick you out for not having admin access.

title: Help popup not opening from Add User page
description: On the Add User page, click the Help button in the corner. The help popup should open, but instead nothing happens.

title: Old responses stay on new user form after hitting cancel button
description: Start filling out a new Add/Create User form, then hit cancel. After being redirected to the Add User page, start the form again. The old responses appear in the answer fields even though they should have been cleared.

title: New user already exists error not appearing
description: Create a new user with the same display name but a different user name than an existing user, then hit submit. An error should appear saying that user already exists, but nothing shows up. However, if you check the database, that user doesn't appear, so they are correctly getting blocked as a duplicate.

title: Add search on help popup
description: At the top of the help pop-up, there should be a search bar. When a user inputs a search, a list of related help articles should appear that they can click on.

title: Help popup search not working
description: Open the help popup from one of the "Help" links, then enter a phrase in the search bar which should have results, like "add user." Instead, the page says "no results found."

title: Index links "page not found"
description: Open the "index" page from the help popup and click the link for one of the topics. This should redirect to the relevant help article, but instead a "page not found" error appears.
